name: glitch-blocks
description: 8x8 block-placement puzzle for PS Vita homebrew (VitaSDK, MIT)
long_description: An 8x8 block-placement puzzle for the PS Vita, as homebrew for consoles running HENkaku (or another taiHEN-based homebrew enabler). Drop pieces from a tray of three onto the grid, fill rows and columns to clear them, and keep going as long as anything still fits. Neon-on-black look, synthesised chiptune audio, no network, no ads.
